limitations: The meaning of the group labels WT, P2, P3, I2, I3 is not stated in the deposit or the paper. Letters were not decoded (e.g. as PTEN or IRE1a knockouts); the paper describes proteomics of IRE1a KO clones #2 and #3 (3 KO vs 4 WT tumors), which does not match the 16 deposited samples (4 WT + 12 others). Labels are kept verbatim.

Organ part, cell type, developmental stage, strain and sex are `not available`; strain FVB is mentioned in the paper for the Fig 2A tumors but is not asserted because the deposited samples could not be matched to that experiment.
The mouse templates require these columns, hence `not available`; the cell-lines template was not used because the samples are tumors, not cultured cells.
Dissociation method is not stated (only NCE 38), so not available.
Deposited PXD044287_community_annotated.sdrf.tsv was not consulted, per workflow.
All 16 TMTpro channels (126-134N) carry samples per metadata.csv; one TMTpro plex with 12 fractions, so a single batch.
Modification positions: Acetyl on protein N-term and TMTpro on any N-term per Mascot .dat IT_MODS headers (three files read); enzyme in .dat is Trypsin/P while the SDRF follows the prose (Trypsin).
